L2_Triage_Playbook.Step_1: Isolate the recipient's corporate email address from the principal field.
L2_Triage_Playbook.Step_2: Verify if the browser click was permitted or successfully blocked by Proofpoint.
L2_Triage_Playbook.Step_3: If permitted, immediately initiate an endpoint sweep in SentinelOne to search for active memory adjustments or browser-spawned shell processes.
